stories.title: 'The stories, those are the things that helped me get here': Food reviewer 'Unc' finds his purpose, one small business at a time
stories.summary: Derrick Moore once prayed for someone to film his struggling restaurant. Now his videos send customers to restaurants across Northeast Ohio.

stories.title: Cuyahoga County Public Library, Akron-Summit County Public Library report 3rd-party data breach led to cardholders' info being compromised
stories.summary: The Cuyahoga County Public Library and Akron-Summit County Public Library have shut down their apps after a third-party vendor breach exposed cardholder information.

stories.title: Gabby Petito's family discuss improving missing-person response at Northeast Ohio AMBER Alert Conference
stories.summary: Nichole Schmidt, Gabby Petito's mother, and Tara Petito, her stepmother, spoke Wednesday at the 2026 Northeast Ohio AMBER Alert Conference in Independence.

stories.title: Tensions flare at meeting to discuss new East Side high school in Cleveland, with Collinwood and Glenville residents fighting to preserve their roots
stories.summary: Community tensions rise amid plans for a new $100M high school merging two historic Cleveland rivals, sparking debates over history, facilities, and even the name.

stories.title: 'I have never seen a crime like this': 11-year-old girl sentenced to 7 years in juvenile custody for brutal assault on 5-year-old in Cleveland
stories.summary: The girl was previously found delinquent for the attempted murder and sexual assault of a 5-year-old girl in a field near East 148th Street and St. Clair Avenue.

stories.title: Firefighter treated for minor burn injuries while battling overnight fire in Canton
stories.summary: "Upon arrival, fire crews observed heavy fire showing from the front porch and first-floor windows of a two-story side-by-side duplex."

stories.title: 'Back in the game': Cleveland Browns legend Bernie Kosar discusses recovery 1 year after liver transplant surgery
stories.summary: Kosar was back at University Hospitals on Wednesday, marking one year since his life-saving liver transplant by sharing his recovery journey.

stories.title: Mentor Public Schools to close 3 elementary buildings, move 8th grade to high school as part of consolidation plan
stories.summary: Mentor's Bellflower, Fairfax and Sterling Morton will close after this school year as part of a consolidation plan projected to save $17 million over five years.

stories.title: OHSAA members to vote on separate sports tournaments for public, private schools
stories.summary: Ohio high school principals will vote on a proposal to separate public and private schools into distinct state sports championships starting in 2028.

stories.title: Meet the 'Perfectly Imperfect' cover dogs of a calendar celebrating rescue pets: Ready Pet GO!
stories.summary: From hairless siblings to senior dogs, photographer Greg Murray's 2027 calendar celebrates the beauty of being different -- while supporting a Cleveland non-profit.

stories.title: Ohio US Sen. Jon Husted delivers farewell speech on Senate floor
stories.summary: Husted said his career was driven by two priorities: education and the economy.

stories.title: Medical Mutual of Ohio may be out of network with Mercy Health if agreement not reached by end of year
stories.summary: The contract ends Dec. 31, and Medical Mutual of Ohio would be out of network starting Jan. 1, 2027, if a new agreement is not reached, according to Mercy Health.
